0022600092.text: Both teams open the 2026-27 season in this game, with the Trail Blazers hosting the Phoenix Suns. Portland is without Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery), and Chris Youngblood, Jrue Holiday and Micah Potter are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and has Luke Kennard and Oso Ighodaro listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-2 in Portland's disfavor, but the Trail Blazers won their most recent meeting 92-77 in Phoenix, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Portland a 60% chance to win.
